messages.subject: [D-RUG] Take your R coding to the NEXT LEVEL with Custom Functions Coding Workshop!
parts:
Hi D-RUGies!

This week we will be having a workshop on how to write your own functions! If this sounds scary, don't worry. There will be step by step instructions and live coding to walk you through the process! If you have ever lamented having to make the same change or correction many places in your code or if you find yourself copy/paste/modifying your code a lot, this workshop will be super helpful! Even if you don't do these things, functions can be a great way to organize your code and take your reproducibility skills to the next level.

The workshop run from 10am to 10:45 or 11am depending on how many questions people have, and then we will have the regular question asking/co-working time.

Datalab will also be open for Tea Time and Co-working on Thursday afternoon.

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09
Tea Time: 1-2pm, DataLab Classroom, Library 360
Co-working: 2-4pm, DataLab Classroom Room, Library 360

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
